sensitivity_sibling_clusters.definition: Secondary sensitivity analysis only (fixed 24 Nov 2026, before any TEST result). A sibling is a TEST item in the same benchmark sharing the cluster value of an excluded item. The analysis removes these clusters entirely and is reported separately; it never replaces the primary results.
